basis: Live validated Bleepblogs and Blog-gold editor workflows; Blog-gold live test explicitly requested by operator
guardrails: Inspect the actual live account and free posting route per hostname
Wait until Publish has no disabled HTML, CSS or ARIA state; never force-enable it
Preserve approved text with block boundaries and exact href values when the editor normalizes HTML
Journal before Publish; never repeat an uncertain final click without an explicitly authorized and inspected continuation
Wait for the actual receipt using a correctly encoded locator; do not infer success from click return
Observe and validate the public business subdomain from Visit Site
Independently verify the eligible detail page in a fresh browser context
Diagnostic test URLs do not add another counted hostname
Template observations do not enable a general queue adapter
account_response_wait: Bounded state-based read-only polling, up to 20 seconds / 20 reads; never repeats the account action
account_registration_match: Actual labels blog name / your email / password and inspected HTTPS same-origin POST /register schema; no per-host source allow-list
